column1: # CONTRACT GRAPH -- the edges that actually break. Tab-separated. Read by tools/audit_graph.py.
# A CONTRACT is a fact that must be true in more than one file. Each has exactly ONE
# authority; every other file holding it is a DERIVED COPY. Drift between them is the
# defect class that produced every inversion of 2026-08-02/03.
# ARCHIVE LAW (Chad-ratified, 2026-08-03): archive the outgoing version in the bump
# commit, reconstructed from the emitter as it stood -- NEVER back-filled from the
# current list. An archive is a claim about the past; building one from present state
# produces a false contract wearing a version number. C3 below is that law's corpse.
# INERT-CHECK LAW: a check that stops matching is not a passing check. Every probe here
# fails RED when its anchor goes stale, never silently. (G21's five emitter-mutation
# anchors and check_tape's constant-column check both went inert on the v3 bump; one
# went RED by guard, one stayed GREEN. Only the guard is acceptable.)
# AUTHORITY RULE: the authority is the file that PHYSICALLY DOES THE THING. For the row
# contract that is the emitter format string -- not any schema describing it. Everything
# else is a description, and a description that disagrees with the artefact is wrong by
# definition, however official it looks.
# probe grammar (see tools/audit_graph.py):
#   sha256                     -> file digest, first 16 hex
#   json_len:<dotted.path>     -> len() of the list/dict at that path
#   json_key:<dotted.path>     -> stringified value at path
#   json_required_count        -> len of required|fields|columns, first found
#   tsv_max_ord                -> max int in column 0 of data rows
#   tsv_field:<rowkey>:<col>   -> cell by first-column key, 0-indexed col
#   regex_capture:<pattern>    -> first capture group of first match
#   regex_count:<pattern>      -> number of matches
#   literal:<value>            -> constant
# derived_copies entries: <path>::<probe>[::<prefix to strip before comparing>]
